title: Sunday Gameday Preview: Week 6 Final Lineup Decisions
excerpt: Final lineup decisions for week 6, taken only against the games that have not kicked off: who is still to play, which designations are open, and where the platform is putting its claims.
author: FSN Desk
bodyHtml:
Sunday, before the next kickoff

A lineup decision only exists for a game that has not started. These are those games.

  • ARI at LAR, Sunday 4:05 PM ET, divisional.
  • BUF at LV, Sunday 4:25 PM ET.
  • LAC at KC, Sunday 4:25 PM ET, divisional.
  • DAL at GB, Sunday 8:20 PM ET.
  • WSH at SF, Monday 8:15 PM ET.

Late status to check

Sleeper carries no designation on any player on the board below. Check your own starters against the inactives list regardless: this column sees the platform, not your lineup.

Still to play, and still claimable

These are Sleeper's platform-wide add counts for week 6 of the 2026 season: how many leagues across the whole platform claimed each player in the last 24 hours. Read them as demand rather than as value. Grouped by game below, in the order the week is played. Every name here has a game that has not kicked off; the ones whose games are running were taken out rather than written about.

ARI at LAR, Sunday 4:05 PM ET, divisional.

Tyler Higbee is the name the whole platform is already on: 1,096,020 adds in a day stops being a tip and starts being an auction, and ARI is the game everyone paid for. Sleeper lists Tyler Allgeier first on the ARI depth chart at RB, which is the entire case, and 309,170 managers have already acted on it.

BUF at LV, Sunday 4:25 PM ET.

Quieter, and a listed starter anyway: Kirk Cousins is first at QB for LV on 186,192 adds, which is the part of this board nobody is bidding against.

WSH at SF, Monday 8:15 PM ET.

Sleeper lists Rachaad White first on the WAS depth chart at RB, which is the entire case, and 278,778 managers have already acted on it.

Locked, and out of the preview

These board players are past their kickoff, so they are reported here rather than previewed above:

BAL at CLE, already underway, divisional.

Jaleel McLaughlin is playing as this is filed. There is no final line to give him yet, which is also why he is not in the preview above.

CAR at PHI, already underway.

Dameon Pierce is playing as this is filed. There is no final line to give him yet, which is also why he is not in the preview above. Tanner McKee is playing as this is filed. There is no final line to give him yet, which is also why he is not in the preview above. Darren Waller is playing as this is filed. There is no final line to give him yet, which is also why he is not in the preview above.

CHI at ATL, already underway.

Roschon Johnson is playing as this is filed. There is no final line to give him yet, which is also why he is not in the preview above.

NO at NYG, already underway.

Najee Harris is playing as this is filed. There is no final line to give him yet, which is also why he is not in the preview above.

The scoreboard has 9 week 6 games running or final. Nothing in the preview above is drawn from them.

Sources: Sleeper public API for add counts over the last 24 hours, and the public NFL scoreboard for kickoff times, game states, final scores and box scores.
